title: Your designs
lead: You have seen four directions. Tell us which one fits and how it should feel.

questions.label: Which demo feels closest to your business overall?
Demo 1 — what do you like? What would you change or leave behind?
Demo 2 — what do you like? What would you change or leave behind?
Demo 3 — what do you like? What would you change or leave behind?
Demo 4 — what do you like? What would you change or leave behind?
Are there any specific sections you definitely want to keep as is from any of the demos?
questions.help: Please indicate the section and demo. A section can be labeled by the content in it. For example: the very first section from Demo 2, services section Demo 4, and Colors from Demo 3

questions.label: Which words best describe how you want your website to feel?
questions.help: You told us this before your designs — correct it if it has changed.

questions.label: Which words do NOT describe how you want your website to feel?
When someone lands on your website, how do you want them to feel?
Do you currently have a logo?
questions.help: Upload it here, or give the font name and hex codes in the next box.

questions.label: Logo font and colors, if applicable
questions.help: Where did you get the font (Canva Pro, for example), when do you use it, what hex code is it, and how else do you use your brand colors — background, buttons, and so on.

questions.label: Do you have a formal brand guide?
questions.help: Upload it here, or name the fonts and colors in the next box. If you'd like one, we can recommend a freelance brand designer. That adds one to five weeks, or we can add new branding after launch.

questions.label: What other fonts and colors do you use, where and when?
questions.help: If you liked something used in one of your demos better than what you use now, say so.

questions.label: What photos would you like used on your website?
questions.help: Your Drive folder is linked in the email with this questionnaire — upload them there and note where you'd like any of them used. If you'd rather see a full demo first, skip this.
